cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-830 specifically involves including external web functionality/widgets from untrusted domains. This code configures security policy for existing Flash functionality but does not demonstrate inclusion of new web functionality from external sources.

connection.evidence: User-controlled options.trustedOrigins and options.trustedDomains flow directly to the flashvars parameter embedded in HTML object/embed tags, configuring Flash's cross-domain security policy.

diff_causality.evidence: This line was added in the diff and is the only place where trustedOrigins parameter is constructed and passed to Flash. Without this line, the security policy configuration would not be sent to the Flash object.

security_control.evidence: URL encoding is applied but no validation of origin format or security policy. The code accepts any string/array from caller without allowlist validation.
security_control.required_control: Origin validation/allowlist for Flash security policy configuration
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: Flash security policy requires validated origins to prevent cross-domain policy manipulation
existing_controls_checked: no validation of origin format or security policy
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No validation that origins are legitimate domains; any caller-provided string is accepted and passed to Flash security configuration

concrete_impact.evidence: Potential to influence Flash's cross-domain policy, but exact security impact depends on Flash movie's behavior and whether malicious origins can bypass same-origin restrictions.

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the trustedOrigins parameter would not be included in the flashvars string, and Flash would use its default security policy instead of user-configured origins.
supporting_evidence: User-controlled options.trustedOrigins and options.trustedDomains flow to flashvars construction
flashvars is embedded in HTML object/embed tags for Flash security configuration
No validation of origin format beyond URL encoding
contradicting_evidence: CWE-830 requires inclusion of external web functionality; this code configures security for existing Flash functionality
unresolved_facts: Whether Flash movie enforces validation on trustedOrigins beyond what is passed
Exact security impact of malicious trustedOrigins on Flash's cross-domain policy
